checks.binarytrees: Each recursive invocation returns a fresh Luau table, including leaves. Stretch tree is scoped and discarded; long-lived root stays live until final recursive check. Bounded identity witness verifies 16,384 distinct real nodes in each mode.
checks.fannkuchredux: Mike Pall permutation generation and prefix flipping compute both alternating checksum and maximum. Small N=0,1,2 guards are outside the measured N=12 path. The outer-loop witness visits all 40,320 N=8 permutations in each mode.
checks.fasta: All required 2N/3N/5N bases are generated. The random generator advances once per base with seed carried between random records; lookup tables implement the prescribed probabilities. Header, newline and remainder behavior passed the shared cases.
checks.knucleotide: Exact THREE token, stopping at next record, comments and CR/LF handling are retained. Histograms traverse all width-1/2 windows; each query traverses all overlapping windows with exact base-4 keys up to 36 bits, below double integer precision.
checks.mandelbrot: Every prescribed pixel iterates the escape recurrence up to 50 times; PBM row padding and tail widths passed exact bounded outputs. No image/result lookup is present.
checks.nbody: Five prescribed bodies, momentum offset, all ten pair interactions per step, position updates and two energy computations remain in Luau with 64-bit numeric arithmetic.
checks.pidigits: Unbounded sequential spigot computes independent floor extractions at 3 and 4 before emission. GMP bindings expose only general integer construction/arithmetic/conversion; there is no native digit or spigot operation.
checks.regexredux: Luau orchestrates input cleaning, all nine nonoverlapping counts and the five ordered replacements. PCRE2 bindings expose only general compile/find/replace operations, with compilation inside each fresh process.
checks.revcomp: Luau handles records, comments, case-insensitive IUPAC mapping, reverse traversal, output wrapping and invalid-byte rejection. No host reverse-complement or table translation operation is present.
checks.spectralnorm: Luau evaluates the coefficient function and all matrix/vector products for ten AtAv pairs, with independent result arrays and the prescribed final quotient and square root.
